_meta.title: Session 40 — Deep re-mine round 2: Opus 4.8 sys card missing benches + SkillOpt full paper + WorldArena Track 2 Policy + AA CritPT/MMLU-Pro full leaderboards via Playwright
_meta.context: User-requested second deep-investigation pass. After S39 surfaced sub-bench backfills, this session targets 6 sources with deeper unmined regions: (1) Opus 4.8 system card pp17-234 — Table 8.1.A had been mostly mined in S33 but 3 frontier benches missed scores for opus-4.8 + 7 NEW benchmarks (AutomationBench, BioPipelineBench, BioMysteryBench Human-Solvable, GMMLU/MILU/INCLUDE multilingual, AECI agentic-economy index); (2) SkillOpt 2605.23904 full Table 1 — Microsoft/SJTU/Tongji/Fudan executive-strategy paper, 5 frontier models × 6 new benches × 2 conditions; (3) WorldArena Track 2 Policy Evaluator HF Space JSON now PUBLIC (was unavailable in S38); (4) AA CritPT Playwright extracted full 33-model chart (15 net-new rows after S38's 22); (5) AA MMLU-Pro AA full 14-model chart (7 net-new after S38's 2). Vellum: confirmed Resources-only — 8/12 candidates MATCH existing DB and 4 DIFF cases DB values are vendor first-party (preserve).
_meta.rule: STRICT-ATTRIBUTION. Opus 4.8 net-new validated by direct PDF page citation (pages 17/41/193-194/216-217/222-225/230-234). SkillOpt direct Table 1 extraction (5 frontier rows: GPT-5.5/GPT-5.4/GPT-5.4-mini/GPT-5.2/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B). WorldArena Track 2 Policy from worldarena-results(policy evaluator)/*.json on HF Space (6 models, latest commit 2026-05-29). AA CritPT/MMLU-Pro full leaderboards extracted via Playwright SVG label nodes — only net-new rows (mapping to existing DB models) ingested; skip new vendors (Gemini 3 Deep Think, K2 Think V2, Mistral Medium 3.5, Solar Pro 3, Nova 2.0 Pro Preview, Gemma 4 31B) to stay focused. CLOBBER-SAFE: All scores are NEW benches OR existing-bench-new-model combinations; SkillOpt scores on NEW benches only (no existing SearchQA/LiveMath in DB); AA scores on mmlu_pro_aa/critpt only for models without existing entries on those benches. SKIPPED: SkillOpt baseline (no-skill) scores avoid duplicate model rows on same benches; Opus 4.8 figure-only sections (Petri 3.0, HealthBench Pro per-slice, CoT controllability sub-bars); LocateAnything no-tools variants of chartmuseum/lab_bench_figqa (sub-variant noise); WorldArena Track 2 Data Engine (7 anonymous competition models × 5 tasks, too noisy); SkillOpt SpreadsheetBench/OfficeQA/DocVQA/ALFWorld (clobber risk with existing); Track 3 Action Planner (not yet released per CVPR challenge schedule).
